ops.title: Baseline release 2026.10.13: A project closed to contributions (the default) has no CI: no workflows, and GitHub Actions turned off. Its declared tests and gates run in git hooks (tend's checks and the tests a change reaches before a commit, all of them before a push), and checks for other systems run on your own machines through Nix remote builders. A check no machine here can run is the exception: its workflow stays, with a decision in the journal that waives ci.closed and says why.
